project_title: Enterprise AI OS - Non-GPU Backlog Clearance & Application Hierarchy Blueprint

overview.objective: Clear non-GPU backlog, establish strict application hierarchy alignment with HTML prototypes, define 5 deferred enhancement proposals, and specify visual, accessibility, and navigation guidelines for main agent implementation.

my_work.rules: Board, My Team, and Company Goals MUST be rendered as delivery support subcomponents inside 'My Work', not as standalone top-level application launcher items.

grey_mirror.rules: State, Record, Under Watch, and Decisions are capabilities/subitems of 'The Watch' inside 'Grey Mirror'. Remove State, Record, Under Watch, and Decisions from standalone top-level launcher presentation.

deferred_enhancement_proposals.name: Cross-Application Context Continuity
deferred_enhancement_proposals.description: Preserve active context (selected model, session token, active task) seamlessly when moving between My Work, Grey Mirror, and ThinkLab.

deferred_enhancement_proposals.name: In-Place Blocker Resolution
deferred_enhancement_proposals.description: Allow users to request or resolve DAP access approvals directly within current view without navigate-away redirects.

deferred_enhancement_proposals.name: Goal-Linked Delivery Matrix
deferred_enhancement_proposals.description: Connect Board tasks and Team activities directly to active Company Goals with visual metric progress bars.

deferred_enhancement_proposals.name: Actionable Watch Audit Drill-Down
deferred_enhancement_proposals.description: Enable 1-click execution trace inspection from Grey Mirror -> The Watch -> Decisions directly into Governance Audit Log.

deferred_enhancement_proposals.name: Truthful Responsive Progress & System Telemetry
deferred_enhancement_proposals.description: Provide live indicator badges distinguishing bound operational features from unbound runtime features with clear empty-state actions.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

visual_enhancers.card_style: rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/60 p-6 shadow-sm hover:border-slate-700 transition-all duration-200

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility.test_id_convention: kebab-case data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, tabs, buttons, and app launchers

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 100% UI fidelity to source HTML prototypes (public/prototype/dap_latest.html and v2_os.html).
Do NOT edit pinned source markup directly; apply application layout and hierarchy composition changes cleanly.
Implement My Work as parent app with subcomponents: Board, My Team, and Company Goals.
Implement Grey Mirror as parent app containing 'The Watch', with nested sub-views: State, Record, Under Watch, and Decisions.
Remove State, Record, Under Watch, Decisions, Board, My Team, and Company Goals from standalone top-level launcher.
Provide clear honest empty states (e.g. using src/components/shared/HonestEmpty.jsx) for unbound backend features.
Maintain back navigation, breadcrumbs, and responsive drawer/mobile layouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid attributes on interactive components.
Maintain high UI sharpness, dark-mode elegance, and consistent padding.
Never rely on pure transparent backgrounds for headers or floating menus.
Do not introduce fake backend data; display explicit unbound/pending notices where live APIs are absent.
